title: ENCRYPTED ESCAPE (TECH ESCAPE ROOM)
rules:
1. Each team must consist of exactly two members

2. Teams will be required to solve a series of mathematical clues, tech-inspired riddles and logic puzzles that will lead to a final puzzle.

3. The final puzzle leads to the key that unlocks your escape.

4. Calculators, mobile phones or any external gadgets are not allowed.

5. Teams must maintain decorum, any form of cheating, brute force or tampering with props will lead to immediate disqualification.

6. The event coordinators reserve the right to modify or update rules or terminate participation in case of emergencies, logistics,safety concerns or rule violations.

7. Decisions made by the event coordinators will be final and binding.
judging: 1. Team that cracks the final clue first (provided all the previous riddles and puzzles given to the team have been solved correctly ) will receive the key to escape the room and claim victory.
